summary: Your third Sunday review. You answer 8 questions from the AI backend module with a confidence number, write a retrospective (what broke, why, one habit to change), group your confusions into 3 themes, tag week 3 and plan week 4.
goal: Say what broke in the AI backend module, why, and which one habit you will change.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Retrospective: write 3 things that broke, the real cause, and one habit to change
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Catch up: tick every unfinished step of Day 15 to Day 21, in order
Run git tag week-3 and see tag: week-3 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 4: write one outcome sentence, put 7 sessions in your calendar, and write your drop list
Play the M2 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
